# StatFigure

The headline number.

`LL.StatFigure` · Components · Data

## Use

```jsx
<LL.StatFigure label={…} value={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.StatFigure" label="{{…}}" value="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

The screen's one isolated headline number: Marcellus in gilt with proportional figures. null shows "—".
